title: Cap. X Arg. VIII: the Church never dared that — infants outside the Church born unclean and debtors of eternal death unless secret mercy intervene
pass_a_gloss: But the Church of Christ never dared to establish this: but on the contrary, concerning the state of infants born outside the Church considered in itself, she pronounces that All are born unclean, all die guilty of eternal death, unless the secret mercy of God, by no means revealed unto us, succour certain ones out of order.
pass_b_english: But Christ’s church never dared to settle that. On the contrary, of infants born outside the church considered in themselves she pronounces: All are born unclean; all die debtors of eternal death, unless God’s secret mercy—not revealed to us—helps certain ones beyond the ordinary order.
source_text: At Ecclesia Christi nunquam hoc ausa est statuere: sed e contra, de statu infantium extra Ecclesiam natorum in se considerato pronunciat, Omnes nasci impuros, omnes mori aeternae mortis reos, nisi arcana nobis minime revelata Dei misericordia quibusdam extra ordinem succurrat.
